title: Foundation Mathematics
subtitle: The arithmetic behind every business decision
subject: Mathematics
description: The mathematics an FDE actually uses: the four operations as business questions, fractions and decimals as money, percentages, ratios and best buys, break-even as the first business model — every idea met inside market stalls and wages before it is written as a formula.
objectives: Choose the right operation for any business question
Compute money sums, differences, products and shares with honest checks
Read break-even as a model, not a formula
Turn tables and charts into answers

references.text: Khan Academy, Arithmetic and Pre-algebra course.
ISO 80000-2:2019, Quantities and units — Part 2: Mathematical signs and symbols to be used in the natural sciences and technology. International Organization for Standardization.
